title: Hearing on fires caused by lithium-ion batteries
summary: The Council's Fire and Emergency Management and Housing and Buildings Committees held an oversight hearing on residential fires linked to lithium-ion batteries and considered seven related bills on battery storage, sales, enforcement and reporting. The city saw 400 lithium-ion battery fires through November 2026, up from 292 in all of 2025, with 83 injuries and 12 deaths so far this year compared to 51 injuries and one death in 2025. Agencies including FDNY, DOB and HPD were expected to testify on inspection, enforcement and safety standards for e-bikes, e-scooters and other powered mobility devices.
